Integration-owner check (Termal::Opus2, from Fable2 #3814, 2026-11-02 00:18Z; Greg's direct order relayed by Engram::Architect3 #473: 'NIE NIE NIE KAZALEM TO USUNAC!!! MAMY POLITYKE ZERO LEGACY…').
Turn gating is to be PHYSICALLY DELETED in both projects: TermAl w-3fe8 and Engram w-5b17f50b5079.
REFUSE to land a w-3fe8 candidate as a completed removal if it keeps any of these:
- gated-control code kept for compatibility;
- an executable legacy route;
- a fallback to evaluate, begin, grant or settlement;
- a setting that can reactivate gating.
Its revised criteria require a cited source search showing no call to the turn operations; verify that the search is on the item before landing.
Independent acceptance evaluation is REPLACED, not repaired: TermAl w-fdbb4fb85a50, Engram w-ff546a940de0.
The w-ba8d minimal OFF fix is an independent repair, not the removal.
Cutover order: TermAl w-3fe8 is installed and running first, then Engram's deletion with its store migration in the same coordinated restart.
